Messages.Author: ramst...@my-deja.com
Messages.Body:
An interesting question came up from our Assamite/Ravnos player.

When an Assamite plays a Contract, the (Assamite) minion who is suppose
to fullfill the contract is selected at the time of play. What happens
to the contract when a Malkavian Antitribu plays Derange on the
Assamite minion chosen to fullfill the contract.

1. Nothing happens to the Contract and the minion can still attack
through the Contract.
or
2. Nothing happens to the Contract but the minion can not attack
through the Contract.
or
3. The Contract is negated due to the chosen Assamite no longer being
an Assamite and no longer eligible to fullfill the contract.

Thanks

Michael Eichler

Sent via Deja.com http://www.deja.com/
Before you buy.

ramst...@my-deja.com wrote:
> An interesting question came up from our Assamite/Ravnos player.
>
> When an Assamite plays a Contract, the (Assamite) minion who is
suppose
> to fullfill the contract is selected at the time of play. What happens
> to the contract when a Malkavian Antitribu plays Derange on the
> Assamite minion chosen to fullfill the contract.
>
> 1. Nothing happens to the Contract and the minion can still attack
> through the Contract.
> or
> 2. Nothing happens to the Contract but the minion can not attack
> through the Contract.
> or
> 3. The Contract is negated due to the chosen Assamite no longer being
> an Assamite and no longer eligible to fullfill the contract.
>

The second is right.
The contract reads "....that Assamite can attack
that minion...".
It says not "....that vampire can attack that minion....";
so, as long as the chosen Assamite is not considered Assamite, say, due
to a Derange's effect or a Clan Impersonation, that Assamite cannot
take the attack action through the played Contract.
At least i think so.
Regards.
Aemilianus, Prince of Rome.
